I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-random. I confirmed the correction, that the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats, and said I wouldn't change anything since they asked for no action.

I didn't read or edit their earlier post in #north-team. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and Ilse posted it in this channel, so repeating it there was fine.
